usage: Plastic (塑膠) is a noun and refers to a synthetic material used in many everyday products.
You can use 塑膠 to talk about objects made from plastic, such as 塑膠杯 (plastic cup) or 塑膠袋 (plastic bag).
In sentences, 塑膠 can be the subject or the object, like in “呢個係塑膠做嘅。” (This is made of plastic).
When describing materials, 塑膠 often pairs with verbs like 做 (make), 用 (use), or 丟 (throw away).
You can also use 塑膠 in compound nouns to specify types of plastic items or materials.
